description: Salesforce CRM platform with REST API, OAuth-based access, and hosted MCP servers for AI agents.
auth_notes: REST API needs an OAuth 2.0 access token via an external client app or connected app; new connected apps restricted as of Spring '26.
gate_detail: REST access needs a Salesforce org (Developer Edition org or dev sandbox used in quick start) plus an authorized app. Hosted MCP is intended only for Flex Credits customers. Whether a free org suffices is not stated.
api_scope: REST API for Salesforce resources; hosted MCP servers expose SObject CRUD, Apex actions, Flows, Data 360 and Tableau.
mcp_notes: Hosted MCP Servers documented by Salesforce; admin setup in org, per-user OAuth 2.0 with PKCE; no endpoint URL given.
blocker_detail: Needs an org, admin-configured external client app, and Flex Credits for hosted MCP; account-plan requirement for REST not established.

evidence.quote: use either an external client app or a connected app and an OAuth 2.0 authorization flow.
To successfully send requests, REST API requires an access token obtained by authentication.
Log in to your Developer org with Salesforce CLI.
Salesforce Hosted MCP Servers are intended only for customers with Flex Credits and you may be billed for server usage.
Salesforce Hosted MCP Servers give AI agents a secure, governed way to interact with Salesforce data and automation.

uncertainties: Whether a free Developer Edition org is sufficient for production use is not stated
Webhook/event support not covered by sources
Hosted MCP server URL not given
S4 docs MCP server is internal-only, not the product MCP
